meta.title: Day 1: Alex's My First Standup
meta.title_zh: 第 1 天：Alex 的入门故事

study_card.difficulty: 入门故事 · 词汇主线
study_card.main_practice: 先听故事 · 再跟读 · 最后替换成自己的经历
value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
电脑硬件与设备 × 问候和自我介绍 × 仓库与 README
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 听读 2 遍 · 遮住中文复述 · 完成输出任务

segments.en: My name is Alex. Today is Monday, my first day at a new job. I am a new engineer. My team makes a chat program. In the morning, Maria shows me the "hardware" and "device". I look carefully and repeat the words. She smiles and says "Nice to meet you." and "How are you doing?". After lunch, she shows me the "repository" and "README file" on GitHub. I am a little nervous, but Maria smiles and says that I can take my time.

I am a little nervous, but Maria smiles and says that I can take my time.
segments.zh: 第 1 天 · 入门故事。今天把“电脑硬件与设备、问候和自我介绍、仓库与 README”放进 Alex 的连续故事。Alex is new on the team. The sentences are short, clear, and easy to repeat.先听一遍，再遮住中文复述；最后把 Alex 换成自己。本段词汇：hardware, device, Nice to meet you., How are you doing?, repository, README file。

hard.def: 硬件，电脑中可以实际触摸到的部件
设备，用来完成某项工作的电子工具
仓库，集中存放项目代码和历史记录的地方
README 文件，介绍项目用途和使用方法的说明文件

segments.en: After the morning meeting, Maria helps me learn the project. She points to the "monitor" and "keyboard" and shows me where the files are. Then she says "My name is ..." and "I'm new here.". I answer slowly and try to sound friendly. Together, we read the "source code" and "project folder" and find the next small task. I do not know every word yet, but I feel better because the team is kind.

segments.en: Before I leave, Maria gives me a small task. I use the "mouse" and "power button" to finish it and then save my work. She asks me about "Where are you from?" and "See you later.". I listen, smile, and say goodbye. Then I open GitHub and look at the "code hosting" and "public repository" with her. It is my first day, and I am ready to learn one small step at a time.
